text_block_list.text:
I came to the cafeteria at lunchtime.
Just as I was about to choose something from the menu—

Eishin Flash stared at the lined-up menu items
with a grave expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It seems my usual order here
is suddenly out of stock today due to ingredient availability...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, the dietary plan I had scheduled
has fallen apart, and I am at a loss for how to handle it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Revising the training menu from scratch now could cause significant delays to our upcoming schedule...
choice_data_list: Since you're here, why not try something you've never eaten before?
Then we have no choice but to quickly rethink the menu.
Then we have no choice but to quickly rethink the menu.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Revising the training menu from scratch now could cause significant delays to our upcoming schedule...
choice_data_list: Since you're here, why not try something you've never eaten before?
Then we have no choice but to quickly rethink the menu.
Then we have no choice but to quickly rethink the menu.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I see. In that case, I shall take this opportunity to expand my dining options at this cafe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That way, we can formulate backup plans and handle unexpected situations like today's...
choice_data_list: We might even stumble upon something delicious unexpectedly.
We might even stumble upon something delicious unexpectedly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. In that case, this change of plans might turn out to be even more meaningful.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your advice.
Having said that, Eishin Flash turned back to choosing from the menu.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...You are quite right.
I simply need to restructure the menu promptly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Cross-referencing the scheduled nutritional intake for today
with the menu currently presented.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your advice.
Having said that, Eishin Flash turned back to choosing from the menu.
